detail_crops.title: Selected leg proportions
detail_crops.caveat: Leg length, reduced lower-leg width and continuous pointed silhouette only. The earlier cap and filament treatment are not approved by this crop.

detail_crops.title: Selected lichen texture
detail_crops.caveat: Compact bob and small lichen structure. Ignore bright facial nodes and do not infer new facial anatomy.

detail_crops.title: Uninterrupted terminal geometry
detail_crops.caveat: One clean lower-leg taper. This is a geometry detail, not a full-body proportion guide.

detail_crops.title: Initial contact
detail_crops.caveat: Intact point at first contact. Use written low-origin rule for subsequent emergence.

detail_crops.title: Lateral hyphal emergence
detail_crops.caveat: Distinction between point and lateral filaments. The visible emergence zone should be tightened to immediately above the substrate.

detail_crops.title: Clean airborne release
detail_crops.caveat: Clean point after release. Any residual substrate filaments are separate from the lifted leg.

detail_crops.title: Organic hand filaments
detail_crops.caveat: Supporting internal-material study. Not approval of hand topology or every visible branch shape.

detail_crops.title: Terrain-following contact
detail_crops.caveat: Branches following leaves, moss, wood and stones. Reduce thickness and regularity where required by the locomotion specification.
